WITH station_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    o.observstation,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) as avg_band_usage,
    COUNT(t.telescregistry) as telescope_count
  FROM observatories o
  INNER JOIN telescopes t ON o.observstation = t.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
),
avg_telescope_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(telescope_count) as avg_count
  FROM station_stats
)
SELECT 
  s.observstation,
  s.avg_band_usage,
  s.telescope_count,
  s.telescope_count / a.avg_count as ratio
FROM station_stats s
CROSS JOIN avg_telescope_count a
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Ignoring missing values in bandusagepct is achieved using SQL's AVG() function, which naturally excludes NULL values per standard SQL semantics.
